_limits: Only verified actual session keys with verified file paths; no fictional message backfill. Public repository; avoid private details.

_session_fields.session_key: Permanent key per actual conversation, not invented ChatGPT ID
_session_fields.latest_archive_path: Verified actual day archive file path
_session_fields.last_activity_local: Timestamp observed from reliable source or null
_session_fields.latest_readable_path: Optional human-readable Markdown diary for the same verified day archive
_session_fields.last_roleplay_message_key: Optional exact key of latest verified real lived roleplay message in a mixed OOC/roleplay session; not the index last_message_key.

_index_policy: Append/update a session only after its verbatim day archive exists and has been read back. Concurrent writes use latest SHA and merge; no fake sessions. Automation may read this index to find verified recent user replies from a different ChatGPT conversation but must not infer read/unread status. A mixed session may be context_kind=ooc for its latest message yet retain last_roleplay_message_key for explicitly relevant prior lived dialogue; use per-message context_kind and do not treat OOC as lived events.
